title: Chromatic X identity
slide_intent: Use a stable symbol across changing color fields so viewers can recognize one identity while experiencing a range of moods.
strategic_value: The luminous X can connect Xfinity’s broad emotional palette to a recurring visual signature.
demonstration: A white X stays central while a luminous background moves through blue, green, orange and magenta over a 15-second loop.
practical_value: Compare the fixed mark with the changing surroundings before deciding which part of an identity should carry variation.

content_islands.name: Luminous X
content_islands.spec: Center the white X and preserve a soft halo around its strokes.

content_islands.name: Changing color field
content_islands.spec: Fill the landscape canvas with saturated color, retaining tonal variation around the stationary mark.

ingredient.name: Light and color
ingredient.role: Give the connection symbol a changing emotional atmosphere.
ingredient.application: Keep the X recognizable while changing the surrounding hue and light. The clip demonstrates several hues without assigning usage percentages.
ingredient.scope: This agency presentation of the Xfinity identity; it is an observed treatment, not a complete palette specification.

reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying venturethree text identifies the X with connection and light and color with the emotions and possibilities connection offers.
reference_purposes.Expression: The clip holds a luminous white X against a sequence of saturated, softly graded color fields.
